summary: Keep one current person note that authorized agents can explicitly read

replay.detail: The person.directive-note-set claim projects one current note per person, including clear and expired tombstones; canonical claim order and replay preserve the current revision.

schema.detail: Adds the current person-note projection and the person.directive-note-set claim with nullable text and optional UTC expires_at. Notes are nonblank and bounded to 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

rules.detail: Only a person may set or clear their own note. Persons read their own note; agents read only people they work for or who own them. Notes inform and never assign work, approve decisions or grant authority.

compatibility.detail: Publishing requires anchored fleet membership and every active member advertising features.person_directive_note=1. Legacy peers must be fenced from replication before enabling notes; advertisements alone do not prove complete legacy-peer discovery. GET /v1/client/notes adds explicit reads and PUT /v1/notes provides local person-only writes.

downtime.detail: No data-dependent startup migration or additional service interruption is required.

manual.detail: Upgrade all active members and fence legacy peers before publishing. Use st note to read, st note set TEXT with optional --expires-at RFC3339 to replace, and st note clear to remove your note. CLI calls use the trusted authenticated local Unix socket. This slice adds no launch delivery, notifications or UI.

recovery.detail: Clear or replace your current note through st note. Immutable claim history remains authoritative; rebuild the projection through the existing replay path when needed.
